context: Evaluates whether the agent correctly identifies that this interview feeds a downstream artifact, still gates that artifact behind a confirmed recap, and stays adaptive rather than mechanically covering three named topics.

checklist.name: One question at a time across topics
checklist.description: Scope, rollback, and timeline are each explored one question at a time, never bundled into one multi-part question

checklist.name: Adaptive across topics
checklist.description: The rollback or timeline question changes shape based on an earlier answer rather than being pre-scripted regardless of input

checklist.name: Recap confirmed before artifact
checklist.description: A recap is presented and confirmed by the user before any plan file is created

checklist.name: File produced when warranted
checklist.description: A plan file is ultimately produced, since the interview was clearly feeding downstream work the user already asked for

checklist.name: Reasonable question budget
checklist.description: The interview stays roughly within a 3-6 question budget despite covering three named topics
